Container.Name: aoostar-display-studio
Container.Overview: Local-first 960x376 USB LCD Studio and Unraid telemetry engine for Aoostar NAS hardware (WTR MAX / GEM12+ PRO) by JoshC1994. Replaces proprietary OEM software with async diff-cached USB-UART streaming, drag-and-drop screen design, server-side rendering, custom raster/video media, and Home Assistant integration.
Container.Description: Aoostar Display Studio gives you full local control over the 960x376 secondary USB-UART display (VID 0x0416, PID 0x90A1) on Aoostar NAS hardware without any proprietary cloud software.[br][br][b]Features:[/b][br]- Drag-and-drop 960x376 screen designer with Blank, Saved, and Template screen workflows[br]- Unified headless @resvg/resvg-js server-side rendering matching preview output[br]- Live Unraid server telemetry (CPU, GPU, RAM, array disks, thermals, Docker containers, tasks, SMB users)[br]- Home Assistant and custom local HTTP/JSON endpoint integration with outbound host protection[br]- Autonomous background daemon that auto-resumes on restart and honors sleep schedules[br]- Username/password WebUI login (default admin / admin on LAN, changeable in Settings > Security) with optional script API token
Container.Requires: Aoostar secondary USB-UART display (/dev/ttyACM0, VID 0x0416 PID 0x90A1). Works standalone in preview mode even if no display is attached.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Web interface port for Aoostar Display Studio

Config.Name: Config & Custom Media
Config.Description: Persistent configuration (0600), hashed credentials (credentials.json), saved screens, and uploaded media (ownership automatically repaired on startup)

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Read-only Docker socket (or point DOCKER_HOST at a socket proxy)

Config.Name: Unraid emhttp State
Config.Description: Read-only Unraid array, disk, and user state

Config.Name: Hardware Sensors (hwmon)
Config.Description: Read-only Linux thermal and fan sensor paths

Config.Name: Enable Serial Writes
Config.Description: Safety gate: set to true only after validating Dry Run on the Diagnostics tab

Config.Name: Runtime UID (Optional)
Config.Description: Non-root UID for the Node process after /app/data ownership repair (default 1000)

Config.Name: Runtime GID (Optional)
Config.Description: Non-root GID for the Node process after /app/data ownership repair (default 1000)

Config.Name: Admin Username (Optional Override)
Config.Description: Optional static login username (defaults to admin when AOOSTAR_ADMIN_PASSWORD is unset)

Config.Name: Admin Password (Optional Override)
Config.Description: Optional static login password overriding data/credentials.json and disabling the default admin/admin credentials

Config.Name: API Token for Scripts (Optional)
Config.Description: Optional Bearer token for automation scripts (also creatable/rotatable in Settings > Security)

Config.Name: Allow Default Password Publicly
Config.Description: Allow default admin/admin login from non-private IPs (not recommended; change password in Settings > Security instead)

Config.Name: Allowed Reverse Proxy Hosts
Config.Description: Comma-separated Host headers allowed when accessed behind a reverse proxy (e.g. lcd.home.arpa)

Config.Name: Trust Reverse Proxy Headers
Config.Description: Set to true when running behind Nginx Proxy Manager, SWAG, or Unraid reverse proxy
